# Association of Health Care Journalists

> A 501(c)3 nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing excellence in health journalism through member support, education, and community engagement.

The Association of Health Care Journalists (AHCJ) serves as the professional home for journalists covering health, medicine, and science. The organization operates the Center for Excellence in Health Care Journalism and relies on tax-deductible donations to support its mission.

## Key Topics

- health journalism
- nonprofit organization
- 501(c)3 status
- membership
- donation
